title: EQUIPOS QUE YA CONFÍAN EN MOMUTO
meta_title: Equipos que Visten MOMUTO: Equipaciones Reales | MOMUTO
meta_descript: Mira a clubes y equipos reales con sus equipaciones MOMUTO personalizadas, sus camisetas en acción. Diseña la de tu equipo sin pedido mínimo.
content:
<style>
    /* LOAD GOOGLE FONTS — MOMUTO BRAND: Bebas Neue (display) + Outfit (body) */
    @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bebas+Neue&family=Outfit:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap');

    /* ===== BRAND VARIABLES ===== */
    :root {
        --rtp-bg: #0a0a0a;
        --rtp-panel: #111;
        --rtp-border: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
        --rtp-border-hover: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
        --rtp-white: #f5f5f5;
        --rtp-muted: #a1a1aa;
        --rtp-dim: #71717a;
        --rtp-red: #c8352e;
        --rtp-red-hover: #e04038;
        --font-display: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
        --font-body: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
    }

    * {
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    body {
        font-family: var(--font-body);
        line-height: 1.6;
        color: var(--rtp-white);
        background: var(--rtp-bg);
    }

    .container {
        max-width: 1400px;
        margin: 0 auto;
        padding: 0 40px;
    }

    /* HIDE CMS GENERATED TITLES */
    .title { display: none !important; }

    /* CMS OVERRIDE FOR SUBTITLE ALIGNMENT */
    .mo-editor-reset p, .mo-editor-reset .main-subtitle, p.main-subtitle {
        text-align: center !important;
        margin-left: auto !important;
        margin-right: auto !important;
    }

    /* --- 1. HERO SECTION --- */
    .equipos-page {
        background: var(--rtp-bg);
        padding: 5rem 0 0 0;
    }

    .section-header {
        text-align: center;
        margin-bottom: 4rem;
        max-width: 900px;
        margin-left: auto;
        margin-right: auto;
    }

    .main-title {
        font-family: var(--font-display);
        font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem);
        font-weight: 400;
        margin-bottom: 1rem;
        color: var(--rtp-white);
        line-height: 1;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    }

    .main-subtitle {
        font-size: 1rem;
        color: var(--rtp-muted);
        font-weight: 300;
        line-height: 1.7;
        max-width: 640px;
        margin: 0 auto;
    }

    /* --- STATS --- */
    .portfolio-stats {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: 6rem;
        padding: 3rem 0;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--rtp-border);
        margin-top: 3rem;
    }

    .stat-item { text-align: center; }

    .stat-number {
        font-family: var(--font-display);
        font-size: 3.5rem;
        font-weight: 400;
        color: var(--rtp-white);
        display: block;
        line-height: 1;
        letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }

    .stat-label {
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        color: var(--rtp-dim);
        margin-top: 0.5rem;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.15em;
        font-weight: 700;
    }

    /* --- 2. CAROUSEL SECTION --- */
    .teams-carousel-section {
        background: var(--rtp-bg);
        padding: 0 0 6rem 0;
    }

    .carousel-header {
        text-align: left;
        margin-bottom: 2rem;
        padding-left: 40px;
        max-width: 1400px;
        margin: 0 auto 2rem auto;
    }

    .carousel-title {
        font-family: var(--font-body);
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--rtp-red);
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.2em;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 1rem;
    }

    .carousel-title::after {
        content: "→";
        font-size: 1rem;
        font-weight: 400;
    }

    .teams-carousel {
        display: flex;
        overflow-x: auto;
        gap: 1.5rem;
        padding: 1rem 40px 3rem 40px;
        scroll-behavior: smooth;
        -ms-overflow-style: none;
        scrollbar-width: none;
    }

    .teams-carousel::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .team-card {
        flex: 0 0 28vw;
        min-width: 320px;
        max-width: 450px;
        background: transparent;
        border: none;
        cursor: pointer;
        position: relative;
    }

    .team-image {
        width: 100%;
        height: 420px;
        background: radial-gradient(circle at center, #1a1a1a 0%, #0e0e0e 100%);
        border: 1px solid var(--rtp-border);
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        margin-bottom: 1rem;
        transition: transform 0.4s ease, border-color 0.25s ease;
    }

    .team-image img {
        width: 90%;
        height: 90%;
        object-fit: contain;
        transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.165, 0.84, 0.44, 1);
        filter: drop-shadow(0 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5));
    }

    /* Hover Effects */
    .team-card:hover .team-image {
        transform: translateY(-5px);
        border-color: var(--rtp-border-hover);
    }
    .team-card:hover .team-image img { transform: scale(1.1); }

    .team-info { padding: 0; text-align: left; }

    .team-name {
        font-family: var(--font-display);
        font-weight: 400;
        color: var(--rtp-white);
        font-size: 1.4rem;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.02em;
        margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
        line-height: 1.1;
    }

    .team-location {
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        color: var(--rtp-muted);
        font-weight: 300;
        margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }

    .team-league {
        background: rgba(200,53,46,0.1);
        color: var(--rtp-red);
        border: 1px solid rgba(200,53,46,0.3);
        padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem;
        font-size: 0.6rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        display: inline-block;
        line-height: 1;
    }

    /* --- 3. GALLERY --- */
    .action-gallery-section {
        background: var(--rtp-panel);
        color: var(--rtp-white);
        padding: 6rem 0;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--rtp-border);
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rtp-border);
    }

    .gallery-title {
        font-family: var(--font-display);
        font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
        font-weight: 400;
        color: var(--rtp-white);
        margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
        text-align: center;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.03em;
        line-height: 1;
    }

    .gallery-subtitle {
        color: var(--rtp-muted);
        font-size: 1rem;
        font-weight: 300;
        text-align: center;
        margin-bottom: 3rem;
    }

    .gallery-filters {
        text-align: center;
        margin-bottom: 2rem;
    }

    .filter-btn {
        background: transparent;
        color: var(--rtp-muted);
        border: 1px solid var(--rtp-border);
        border-radius: 0;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.15em;
        padding: 0.8rem 1.5rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        margin: 0 4px 8px 4px;
        cursor: pointer;
        font-family: var(--font-body);
        transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }

    .filter-btn.active, .filter-btn:hover {
        background: var(--rtp-red);
        color: #fff;
        border-color: var(--rtp-red);
    }

    .masonry-gallery {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
        gap: 4px;
    }

    .action-photo {
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        cursor: pointer;
    }
    .action-photo img {
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        display: block;
        transition: transform 0.5s ease;
    }

    .action-overlay {
        position: absolute;
        bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
        background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.5) 40%, rgba(0,0,0,0.95) 100%);
        color: white;
        padding: 2rem 1.5rem 1.5rem 1.5rem;
        opacity: 0;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
        transform: translateY(10px);
    }

    .action-overlay .team-name {
        font-family: var(--font-display);
        font-weight: 400;
        font-size: 1.2rem;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.02em;
        color: #fff;
        text-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
        line-height: 1.1;
    }

    .action-overlay .team-details {
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        font-weight: 300;
        color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
        margin-top: 4px;
    }

    .action-photo:hover img { transform: scale(1.05); }
    .action-photo:hover .action-overlay { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }


    /* --- 4. UGC & FOOTER --- */
    .ugc-cta-section {
        background: var(--rtp-panel);
        border: 1px solid var(--rtp-border);
        padding: 4rem;
        margin: 4rem auto 0 auto;
        max-width: 1320px;
        text-align: center;
    }

    .ugc-title {
        font-family: var(--font-display);
        color: var(--rtp-white);
        font-weight: 400;
        font-size: 2rem;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.02em;
        line-height: 1;
        margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }
    .ugc-subtitle {
        color: var(--rtp-muted);
        font-weight: 300;
        margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }

    .btn-secondary {
        background: transparent;
        color: var(--rtp-white);
        padding: 15px 30px;
        border: 2px solid var(--rtp-white);
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.15em;
        font-size: 0.75rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        display: inline-block;
        text-decoration: none;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
        font-family: var(--font-body);
    }
    .btn-secondary:hover {
        background: var(--rtp-red);
        color: #fff;
        border-color: var(--rtp-red);
    }

    .footer-cta-wrapper {
        background: var(--rtp-red);
        padding: 8rem 0;
        margin-top: 4rem;
    }
    .final-cta-section { text-align: center; }
    .cta-title {
        font-family: var(--font-display);
        color: #fff;
        font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
        font-weight: 400;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.02em;
        line-height: 1;
        margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .cta-description {
        color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
        font-size: 1rem;
        font-weight: 300;
        margin-bottom: 3rem;
        max-width: 640px;
        margin-left: auto;
        margin-right: auto;
    }

    .btn-primary {
        background: #fff;
        color: var(--rtp-bg);
        padding: 20px 50px;
        border: none;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.15em;
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        cursor: pointer;
        display: inline-block;
        text-decoration: none;
        transition: transform 0.2s;
        font-family: var(--font-body);
    }
    .btn-primary:hover { transform: scale(1.05); }

    /* --- 5. LIGHTBOX --- */
    .lightbox {
        display: none;
        position: fixed;
        z-index: 9999;
        left: 0; top: 0;
        width: 100%; height: 100%;
        background-color: rgba(10,10,10,0.95);
        animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease;
        justify-content: center;
        align-items: center;
    }
    .lightbox.active { display: flex; }

    .lightbox-content {
        max-width: 900px;
        max-height: 90vh;
        position: relative;
        box-shadow: 0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
        background: transparent;
    }

    .lightbox-image {
        max-width: 100%;
        max-height: 85vh;
        display: block;
    }

    .lightbox-close {
        position: absolute;
        top: -40px; right: 0;
        font-size: 30px;
        color: var(--rtp-white);
        cursor: pointer;
        z-index: 100;
    }

    @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }

    /* SR-ONLY */
    .sr-only {
        position: absolute;
        width: 1px;
        height: 1px;
        padding: 0;
        margin: -1px;
        overflow: hidden;
        clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
        white-space: nowrap;
        border: 0;
    }

    .action-photo figure { margin: 0; }
    .action-photo figcaption { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; pointer-events: none; }
    .action-photo figcaption .photo-meta { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }

    /* "+ MORE DESIGNS" placeholder card on dark theme */
    .team-card-placeholder {
        background: var(--rtp-panel) !important;
        border: 1px dashed var(--rtp-border) !important;
    }
    .team-card-placeholder-text {
        font-family: var(--font-display);
        color: var(--rtp-dim) !important;
        font-weight: 400 !important;
        font-size: 1.2rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    }

    /* RESPONSIVE */
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
        .main-title { font-size: 2.5rem; }
        .portfolio-stats { gap: 2rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
        .team-card { flex: 0 0 75vw; }
        .team-image { height: 350px; }
        .masonry-gallery { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        .carousel-header { padding-left: 20px; }
        .teams-carousel { padding: 1rem 20px 3rem 20px; }
        .container { padding: 0 20px; }
        .ugc-cta-section { padding: 2.5rem 1.5rem; }
    }
</style>
